color-system.twistDescription: Copied verbatim — no modification. color_register=light verified: chalk-signal pageBackground #f2f2f2 luminance 242 (>190).

type-system.twistDescription: Twist E: Body size compression at 0.88× — body: 12px→10.56px, p: 16px→14.08px, link: 12px→10.56px. Heading sizes unchanged. Generic sans-serif body/link resolved to Inter (already in system). All fonts verified in known-google-fonts.md.

motion-system.twistDescription: Twist A: Duration scaling (slower) ×1.3 — all numeric durations multiplied. xfast: 0.18s→0.234s, fast: 0.27s→0.351s, medium: 0.36s→0.468s, slow: 0.9s→1.17s, xslow: 1.08s→1.404s, pulse: 2.52s→3.276s. Produces unhurried, measured pacing.

grid-system.twistDescription: Twist A: Container max-width tightened 15% at intensity 2 — 780px→663px. Creates more editorial, constrained reading column. Simplified to practical 3-grid set: 12-column, 2-col symmetric, 2-col asymmetric.

spacing-system.twistDescription: Twist B: Section-specific breathing room at intensity 3 — section gap +32px (30px→62px), section paddingBlock added as 32px. Layout section padding-bottom and row-gap each +32px. Layout container padding-top +32px. All other spacing tokens unchanged.

interaction-states.twistDescription: Twist E: Focus state enhancement at intensity 3 — outlineWidth: 2px and outlineStyle: solid enforced on all link, navigation, and input focus states. outlineOffset: 2px added throughout. New inputs entry added with focus ring. No color values changed.

nav-system.twistDescription: Fix agent replacement — original pick (webflow, fontFamily: 'WF Visual Sans Variable') flagged by Check C for unavailable font family. Replaced with hermes nav (fontFamily: inherit), which harmonizes cleanly with assembled Montserrat/Inter type system. Uppercase micro-typography, hairline right-to-left underline on hover, height 50px.

concept-summary.twistDescription: Twist C: Material shift — rewrote the Typography System section to add specific details about physical materiality: the body text compression described as 'woven, pressed-paper quality' and heading letter spacing described as the feel of 'something printed on thick stock.' concept_by_video.md generated with 3 video placements: hero-product-ambient.mp4 (10s), product-dark-ambient.mp4 (10s), features-ambient.mp4 (5s).

consistencyChecks.checkA_colorContrast: PASS — navText(#000000, lum:0) vs navBackground(transparent→#f2f2f2, lum:242): OK. bodyText(#000000, lum:0) vs pageBackground(#f2f2f2, lum:242): OK.
consistencyChecks.checkB_motionInteractionCoherence: PASS — no numeric hover durations in interaction-states that would trigger 5× comparison.
consistencyChecks.checkC_navFontAvailability: FLAG then FIXED — webflow nav fontFamily 'WF Visual Sans Variable' not in assembled type system. Fixed by replacing with hermes nav (fontFamily: inherit).
